how: A defense alarm calls participants to their posts using the shared language of dwarves and Armok.
Limited space constrains longer lettering and additional bearded dwarves.
Later proposals and joining do not identify the original starter whom builders first joined.
Participants dispute replacing a face with the subreddit signature and defend the signature as a way to identify the artwork.
Proposals for more imagery include beards, an Omega and a time-lapse animation under space constraints.
A participant proposes limiting the gold-tooth motif to prevent the shared artwork becoming a streamer's advertisement.
Participants relay the flag-dwarf colour plan, share a progress image and announce completion.
A helper's inability to locate the artwork elicits directions and a promise to add exact coordinates to the sidebar.
Repairing access information follows a failed attempt to locate active work rather than settlement of a design disagreement.
Bare commitments answer the consolidation proposal alongside a reasoned objection and a subsequent reasoned decision to join.
Participants answer the flag-dwarf proposal with a bare commitment or a commitment deferred until another task is finished.
Own-script interference is suspected, but actual script operation and adjustment remain unverified alongside an alternative manual-restoration explanation.
Voluntary proposals and joining cannot establish the absence of decided order in unseen planning or test a claim about most rooms.

statement: Maintaining discoverable plans across public threads and a separate planning chat
how: Public and chat coordination can coexist while a willing helper cannot locate either useful instructions or the artwork.
Participants rally against the void while another participant explicitly prioritises maintaining the existing pattern over expansion.
Consolidating figures and narrowing gaps are proposed to reduce the area needing defense while preserving room for more imagery.
Defensive redesign requires helpers to recognise planned changes before their preservation efforts undo them.
Participants diagnose apparent vandalism as potentially their own scripts or uninformed manual restoration without settling the cause of every overwrite.
A participant opposes moving the cat because it would threaten peace with a neighbour.
Attributing restraint requires distinguishing hosting participants from visitors offering repair or denying responsibility for expansion.
A pact question receives a visitor's statement of intended flag borders and an offer of rebuilding help.
A visitor identifying with a neighbouring room carries a mutual-help proposal into the hosting room.
Promised defense explicitly repays neighbours for accommodating a shared pickaxe design instead of fighting it.
Respect after a neighbour's loss can be expressed by remaking one's own figure in its colours without restoring the lost flag.
An unanswered alliance request warrants an attempted alliance, not an established coalition or mutual-defense commitment.
Shared imagery warrants artistic accommodation but does not by itself establish that the participating rooms joined a coalition.
Internal compression is visible, but no cited passage identifies relocation caused by erasure or loss of the original spot.
A fused pickaxe and dwarf does not establish guest tenure under another room's territorial authority.
Disowning unplanned flag expansion does not establish a dispute over whether a member's treaty binds other placers.
Participants carry game lore into a defense alarm and answer it through Armok's forges and joking contempt for elves.
Maintaining shared lore includes correcting the public welcome's drink reference and accepting a promised wording change.
Conflict with neighbours is recorded without a cited account of a quarrel predating the canvas.
The displacement account names no prior rivalry, and separate game lore cannot establish why that neighbour was targeted.
A redirect venue is retained for coordination because its larger community will stop accepting canvas submissions.
Game-flavoured welcomes and defense jokes do not establish a separate April Fools takeover or fake-post licence in the host venue.
Participants credit the pickaxe's makers and celebrate the flag dwarf with an announcement that they completed it.
The final-state post and its endurance reply record survival without disputing which version should be kept.
A successor-canvas invitation receives a correction directing participants to an effort reportedly already started elsewhere.
The final-state post and endurance statement contain no contest over cleanup, preferred versions or retrospective correction.

statement: Making the canvas mark a route back to its community
how: A public signature is defended as a way for unaffiliated helpers to discover the community rather than only identify its picture.

statement: Inviting recognised canvas helpers into the underlying activity
how: A participant invites a helper to play the represented game, whose reply limits the outcome to recognising an existing player.
One participant recounts helping push out a neighbouring flag while celebrating the resulting artistic fusion.
The expansion memorial salutes a displaced neighbouring work while acknowledging that there was no room for both.
Respectful remaking and reciprocal help can coexist with reported displacement without demonstrating collective renunciation of expansion.
Joining and progress reports do not establish that a recruitment call brought previously absent members to the canvas.
The original starter and first recruitment sequence cannot be reconstructed from later proposals about existing work.
Existing work and defensive redesign are visible, but the earlier building-to-upkeep transition is not established.
Defense and pact talk appear near one another without a passage establishing that preservation pressure produced negotiation.
A move is rejected explicitly because it would threaten an existing peace, supporting restraint conditional on that relationship.
Suspicion of own-script interference does not show that defensive strain caused script adoption.
Flag-dwarf planning and progress reports precede an explicit completion celebration within the same project thread.
Completion celebration precedes the final-state record, but no cited passage makes celebration the reason for preserving an image.
Final recording precedes successor invitations, but neither invitation says the record prompted continuation.
Limited space prompts internal compression rather than an evidenced move after deciding the original spot cannot be held.
The coordinate fix answers a location complaint rather than demonstrating that a posted pixel template settled design talk.
A proposal receives a bare commitment, supporting the observable proposal-answer pair without proving an obligation to answer.
Accepting a proposal may depend on seeing progress, while hesitation and existing tasks can also make acceptance reasoned or delayed.
Reciprocal defense is explicitly offered in return for artistic accommodation, so shortage of hands is unnecessary to explain that promise.
A pact question receives border clarification and a conditional rebuilding offer, demonstrating negotiation coupled with promised help rather than verified delivery.
A participant reports displacement, but no cited passage establishes that a recruitment call turned those hands toward the target.
Repair language and displacement coexist, but no passage establishes the hosting room refusing its own attack call.
The surviving pact title and visitor's answer cannot recover the deleted opener's attack proposal or prove a move from attack to negotiation.
A salute and a participant's displacement claim do not establish an attack call causing subsequent contest talk.
A threat motivates an incoming alliance request, but acceptance and joint defense remain unseen.
The coordinator cites a host posting restriction, but neither a canvas-post flood nor its causal role is established.
Negotiation receives responsibility and repair statements without a visible challenge to anyone's authority to bind the room.
Reported visible progress leads the same objector to reverse position and join the proposed consolidation.
